# Respiray

> > Respiray designs wearable personal air purifiers and portable cooling devices for clean air and comfort on-the-go.

Respiray is an Estonian company specializing in wearable air purification technology, primarily featuring the Wear A+ device with HEPA and activated carbon filtration. The product line addresses allergies, virus protection, pollution, and portable cooling needs for personal air quality management.

## Key Topics

- Respiray Wear A+
- Wearable air purifier
- HEPA filtration
- Allergy relief
- Virus protection
- Personal air quality
- Respiray Neck Fan
- Portable cooling
- Activated carbon filter
- VOC removal
- Hay fever
- Pet dander
- COVID-19 protection
- Replacement filters
- Estonia

## Use Cases & Benefits

- [Wearable Allergy Relief for Hay Fever & Allergies](https://respiray.com/wearable-allergy-relief-for-allergies-and-hay-fever): Wear A+ wearable air purifier for hay fever, pet dander, and dust allergies
- [Wearable Air Purifier for Viruses & Bacteria](https://respiray.com/wearable-personal-air-purifier-for-viruses-bacteria): Wear A+ HEPA air purifier protection against COVID-19, influenza, and common cold
- [Wearable Air Purifier for Dust, Odors & Pollution](https://respiray.com/wearable-personal-air-purifier-for-dust-and-pollution): Wear A+ with activated carbon filter for odors, fragrance allergies, and pollution
